Tara (People Ops): All-hands in 15m. Quick thread for green-room, a tiny agenda swap, and recording backups. Green room 14:05.
Owen (AV): I'll bring main rig + spare laptop. OBS set to record local + stream. Backup RTMP: rtmp://backup.redwood/allhands. If main drops I'll post fallback note.
Maya (Product): Request: move the "Billing updates" slide to after the roadmap so Qs land with context.
Tara (People Ops): Swapped in deck. Please pop into green room 8m before your slot for a mic check.
Sam (CEO): Keep remarks short so we have 20m for live Qs. I'll monitor this thread and the Google doc.
CaptionBot: Live captions active  latency ~2s  confidence 0.88.
Owen (AV): If OBS CPU >70% switch to NVENC and drop canvas 1080->720. Quick kill if ffmpeg hangs: `pkill -f ffmpeg || true`. Also recording path: /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1823456789.mp4.
RexBot: Recording started  writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1823456789/master.mp4
Tara (People Ops): Legal reminder: mark slides with customer data as "CUSTOMER CONTENT" so Legal can fast-review.
Owen (AV): If public ingest fails we'll still record locally and rsync after show. Rsync snippet: `rsync -av /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1823456789.mp4 gs://redwood-recordings/`
Tara (People Ops): Two-minute warning will be posted here. Follow-up notes + action items posted to #all-hands within 2 hours. Good luck! :sparkles:
